Definition: neuter of a derivative of a compound of G1537 and G1096; a descendant, i.e. (specially) grandchild:--nephew.
BiblicalUsage: This word is a descendant, a grandchild, and Paul uses it once, in his instructions for the care of widows. If a widow has children or grandchildren, he says, let them first learn to show piety at home and to repay their parents, for that is good and acceptable before God. The word puts the family's duty before the church's, and the grandchildren first.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe caring for our own parents and grandparents is part of the gospel, because Paul says the family learns piety at home before it shows it anywhere else.
